slides.title: Landscaper in the off-season, finally relaxing:
slides.body: I just want to be okay.

slides.label: Me:
slides.title: Sleeping past 5 AM for the first time since March.
slides.body: No trailer to hook up. No crew texts. Bliss.

slides.label: Also me, at 2 AM:
slides.title: Wait. Does the applicator license renew this year?
slides.body: Or was that last year? Who would even know?

slides.label: Me:
slides.title: Watching football with zero mowers running.
slides.body: The truck is parked. The blowers are quiet.

slides.label: Also me, at halftime:
slides.title: Did the truck insurance renew, or just the renewal email?
slides.body: And is the trailer registration on the same date or a different one?

slides.label: Me:
slides.title: Coffee on the porch. Nothing to mow.
slides.body: Also me: which HOA asked for a new insurance certificate before spring contracts?

slides.label: I just want to be okay.
slides.title: Put the dates somewhere that reminds you, so your brain doesn't have to.
slides.body: Save this for the slow season.
